title: Fact check: Fake viral videos linked to the Riyadh airport attacks

blocks.text: Smoke and flames following an attack by Houthi rebels at King Khalid Airport in Riyadh Yemen’s Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for a series of attacks on Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid International Airport in recent days. At least 16 people have been killed since last Thursday, according to Saudi authorities. As news of the attacks spreads, social media users have been sharing videos that they claim show the strikes. While some authentic footage of the attacks and their aftermath has circulated online, DW Fact check found that several viral videos are not genuine and show signs of being AI-generated.
